content:
We need to search templates. The tool expects bonds broken/formed as atom index pairs, not O-Si. So we should omit those criteria. We have functional_groups_broken aliphatic hydroxyls. Also we know forward reaction: O-Si bond formed, O-Si broken? Actually protecting alcohol: starting alcohol (O-H) reacts with TMSOTf, forming O-Si bond (new) and breaking O-H bond (hydrogen leaves). The description says "During the reaction a oxygen-silicon bond is broken and another one (O-Si) is formed." That seems odd: maybe they refer to TMSOTf having Si-O bond to OTf that breaks, and new O-Si forms. So we could include bonds_broken: maybe "Si-O" but we don't know indices. So better to search only with functional_groups_broken.

Let's search with functional_groups_broken aliphatic hydroxyls, no other criteria.
